source.metadata_use: Count descriptions and target-region multiplicity only; do not run or score action-family or topology selection.

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first three eligible scenes.

post_admission.algorithm: Frozen SC26 hierarchical action-family witness before unchanged SC21 topology integrity.

forbidden_after_metadata_access: inspect action-family or topology selector output during source admission
select scenes by wrong-part reduction or algorithm outcome
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind SceneFun3D source admission for a fresh SC26 action-family-topology transfer check. Target-region identities and selector outputs are not used for scene ranking. Passing admission does not establish algorithm success, RGB semantic proposal generation, reachability, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
